source: Did You Know? Creating an Exomnus sentence is much like drawing a portrait of a person. First, you sketch the shape of the concept, like the face, and create boundaries. Then you section the material into understandable nuggets – eyes, ears, nose, expression. You keep information simple as you add it, then infuse precise detail like lighting and shadow. Sketching a strong foundation unleashes creative and abstract potentials. With Exomnus, we first use words to create a simple idea. Then we take the Dictopedia, which holds all defined meanings of all words we know, and add precise references to the meanings we want each word to hold. The end result is a highly precise idea!
target: 你知道嗎？ 構造艾克索姆語句子，很像替人畫肖像。先勾勒概念的形狀，如同描繪臉部輪廓，建立邊界。接著，把內容分成容易理解的部分——眼睛、耳朵、鼻子、表情。加入資訊時保持簡單，再賦予光影般精確的細節。穩固的基礎，能釋放創意與抽象思考的潛力。使用艾克索姆語時，我們先用詞語形成簡單概念，再取用收錄所有已知詞語及定義的《辭義百科》，加入精確的參照，指定每個詞應具有的含義。最後，就得到一個高度精確的概念！

Happy 72 years you old wizard! 

Can you still walk? I hope so. Because after reading this card, you need to join us down by the stream for some trout (we found wild dill) and apple compote. Yep, your eyes do not deceive. Heather made the good stuff. 

Tonight, I’m busting out the harmonica. I wrote us another song (inspired by your obsession with the Quentin Brown guy): 

Forever Mine

A river ain’t the same thing twice
Runs straight through hell and paradise
And never takes a loooong look back 

No achin’ feet or sunken heart,
It ain’t got time to fall apart
This perfect amneeeeeesiac
target:
七十二歲生日快樂，你這老巫師！

還走得動嗎？希望可以。因為看完這張卡片，你得來溪邊跟我們一起吃鱒魚（我們找到了野生蒔蘿），還有燉蘋果。沒錯，你眼睛沒花，海瑟做了好東西。

今晚，我要拿出口琴。我又替我們寫了一首歌，靈感就來自你對那位昆汀・布朗先生的癡迷：

永遠屬於我

河水從不兩度相同，
穿越地獄，也穿越天堂，
從不回首久久——凝望。

沒有痠痛雙腳，沒有沉落的心，
它沒有時間分崩離析，
這完美的失憶——者。
